tasks.instruction: Pytania wlasne do mapy mysli OJAJ 2026/27 o Wielkiej Brytanii (nie z arkusza olimpiady). Z podanych odpowiedzi wybierz poprawna. Tylko jedna jest prawidlowa.

items.stem: Who began building the Tower of London?
What is kept in the Tower of London and seen by millions of visitors?
What is the popular name of the Yeoman Warders of the Tower of London?
What does the Monument near London Bridge commemorate?
options: B) the Great Fire of London
C) the coronation of Queen Elizabeth I

items.stem: The Monument is 61 metres tall. What is special about this height?
options: A) It is the height of the old St Paul's Cathedral.
B) It is the distance from the Monument to where the Great Fire started.
C) It is the depth of the River Thames under London Bridge.
D) It is the number of houses that survived the fire.

items.stem: Which king turned Hyde Park into a royal hunting ground in 1536?
What can people do at Speakers' Corner in Hyde Park?
options: A) give a public speech on almost any topic
B) watch the King's Speech on a big screen
D) meet Members of Parliament every Sunday

items.stem: Which words are carved on the Animals in War memorial?
options: D) Keep calm and carry on

items.stem: Who did Queen Victoria build the Albert Memorial for?
How did the Peter Pan statue appear in Kensington Gardens in 1912?
options: A) Children collected money for it for ten years.
B) J. M. Barrie had it put up secretly overnight, as if by magic.
C) It was moved there from Buckingham Palace.
D) It was a present from the people of Scotland.
